title: Aspiring filmmaker here. I have a question.

commenti.body:
Super hard pass on #1.

 # 2 sounds like a great premise for a video game.

Add text Add text Add text Add text Add text Add text Add text Add text Add text Add text Add text Add text Add text Add text Add text

I'm a screener for film festival and I can say that the "road trip to a funeral" idea is done to death by indie filmmakers (and roadtrip movies in general, but funeral ones rank high). Doesn't mean you can't make a good movie out of it, but I yawn at the thought of watching such a movie.

The second one sounds more interesting, but I need more to go on like why is there a need to discover the secret? what happens if she doesn't? and why poems? and how will that translate visually into this fantasy world? Sounds like an idea that might work better in a novel where words have more meaning.

you might pitch these over at r/screenwriting
